title.h1: Resona: Motion that signals meaning before words
title.lede: A living showcase of creative technology grounded in pseudo-haptics. Exploring how tension, mass, and deceleration simulate tactile physical sensation on glass screens.

label.en: External animation dependencies (pure CSS & vanilla JS)
label.jp: アニメーションの外部依存（CSS と素の JS だけ）

label.en: Rock-solid frame rate across mobile and low-power devices
label.jp: モバイルや非力な端末でも落ちないフレームレート

label.en: Core physics archetypes: Tension, Deceleration, Bloom
label.jp: 3 つの物理の型：張力・減速・開花

label.en: Ultralight total footprint for instantaneous loading
label.jp: 合計 15kb 未満、すぐ開く

cells.heading: Pseudo-haptics over physical motors.
body: Physical vibration engines drain battery and feel artificial. By carefully calibrating pointer drag displacement against visual lag and spring recovery, the user's mind projects physical weight directly into the glass surface.

cells.heading: Motion as semantic architecture.
body: Animation in software is usually added last as decoration. Resona treats motion as an upfront semantic grammar: elements signal their importance, elasticity, and irreversibility before a user reads labels.

cells.heading: Zero-fat math curves.
body: Heavy animation packages introduce frame drops and memory overhead. Resona implements lean spring differential equations directly into requestAnimationFrame loops with automatic fallback for reduced motion.

caption.en: Tension — drag displacement read back as weight
caption.jp: Tension — 引っぱりの遅れを重さとして読む
Bloom — 減速して止まるまで

cells.heading: Tactile digital products
body: Sliders, toggles, and payment confirmations that convey tangible confidence.

cells.heading: Data visualization friction
body: Giving mass to data points so anomalies and extremes resist user interaction naturally.

cells.heading: High-end brand presence
body: Understated, calm physics conveying luxury and craft without noisy visual tricks.
